title: Empty-queue Resume clears the persisted pause without advancing the session mutation stamp
outcome: A successful Resume of a paused session with no ordinary queued prompt remains unpaused after the background delta writer persists and SQLite is reloaded.
acceptance: The empty-queue Resume branch advances the affected session mutation stamp before submitting its persistence delta, retaining the existing rollback behavior on commit failure.
A persist/reload regression test first advances the background writer watermark past the paused row, resumes the empty queue, and proves SQLite and the reloaded session are unpaused.

completion.summary: Empty-queue Resume stamps its session before persisting the unpause and retains rollback. SQLite/reload regression passes. Delivered in eb78d349; fresh independent evaluationa9700b42 passed both criteria.
